speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for your patience. To begin our evaluation of your gait and limb ataxia, could you describe exactly how your balance issues started and if they have progressed over time? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your speech, coordination, or memory?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see; could you tell me if you have any known family history of similar gait problems or neurological conditions? Additionally, have you experienced any episodes of numbness, weakness, or visual changes alongside your ataxia?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) due to natalizumab use.
